name: What are common drywall textures in Bay Area homes?

mainEntity.name: What are common drywall textures in Bay Area homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Bay Area homes, common drywall textures include smooth, orange peel, and knockdown. Smooth finishes are popular for a modern, clean look. Orange peel provides a subtle, dimpled appearance, while knockdown offers a slightly bolder, flattened texture. Less common but still present are skip trowel or hand-applied textures, often found in older or custom homes. The choice of texture can impact the aesthetic and resale value of a property.
